name: manual_05079a
claim: A component's shutdown can return normally with its health tripped: a thread that outlived the grace period is reported, not raised. A caller that only guards shutdown raising will then record a finished run as completed. After quiescing on the success path, require the delivery to be healthy and otherwise record an unknown terminal with a delivery-specific reason (delivery.shutdown_incomplete) rather than completed.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review 5509741432 on oramasys PR 36, 2026-10-14: valid once shutdown began waiting for threads; runner-level test with a real observer and a runs_off_loop sink that outlives the grace period failed with DID NOT RAISE before the fix.
